errors.urlScheme: URL must start with http:// or https://, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:1234/v1
errors.urlInvalid: Invalid API URL. Check the IP, port and path.
errors.urlCredentials: URL must not contain a username, password or # fragment
errors.api401: Authentication failed. Check the API key.
errors.api403: Service denied access. Check the key and permissions.
errors.api404: Endpoint not found. Check the port and full path.
errors.api429: AI service rate limited. Try again manually later.
errors.finishReason: AI output did not finish normally ({reason})
errors.sseMalformed: Malformed AI streaming response; received content was kept
errors.sseInterrupted: AI stream ended early; received content was kept and you can retry
errors.notSseOrJson: AI did not return valid SSE or JSON. Check whether a web page URL was entered.
errors.emptyContent: AI returned empty content. Check the model name and service logs.
errors.gmMissing: The script manager did not provide GM_xmlhttpRequest. Check the script's run permissions.
errors.idleTimeout: No data from the AI service for two minutes; stopped. Check whether the model is still loading.
errors.totalTimeout: AI request exceeded ten minutes; stopped
errors.discontinuousResponse: The script manager returned a discontinuous response. Enable compatibility mode and retry.
errors.connectFailed: Cannot reach the AI service. Check that it is running, the address and port, Tampermonkey target-host permissions and browser local-network permission; this error alone cannot identify the exact cause
errors.requestTimeout: AI request timed out. Check that the service and model are ready.
errors.promptTooLong: Custom prompt is too long. Shorten it or raise the input budget.
errors.truncatedOutput: AI output hit the length limit; partial content was kept. Raise the output limit and retry.
errors.packTooLong: Post author info exceeds the input budget. Raise the budget.
errors.digestNotCompressed: Segment digests could not be compressed into the input budget. Raise the budget or shorten the custom prompt; completed digests were kept.
errors.tooManyLayers: Too many summary layers; stopped with segment results kept. Narrow the floor range.
errors.foreignTopicPosts: The site returned posts from a different topic
errors.invalidRange: Enter a valid integer floor range
errors.noProgress: The site returned no further floors. Refresh and retry.
errors.rateLimited: The site is rate limited. Try again in about {seconds}s.
errors.accessDenied: The current login or access permission is unavailable. Log in or complete the site's verification first.
errors.nonJson: The site returned non-JSON content. Check the page for login or access verification.

progress.rateLimited: Site rate limited; waiting to continue…
progress.waitDetail: Waiting about {seconds}s; you can stop anytime
progress.readingDetail: Missing floors keep their original numbers; only content visible to this account is read

warnings.imageTooLarge: Image exceeds the 20 MiB per-image limit
warnings.imagesTooLargeTotal: Total resources exceed the 100 MiB limit
warnings.imageBudgetTotal: Total resources reached the 100 MiB limit
warnings.imageDownloadFailed: Image connection failed or the target host is not authorized
warnings.noVisiblePosts: No posts in the selected range are visible to this account
